entry.title: ARIA 1.3.5
entry.summary: New: ARIA for Linux - VST3, LV2 and a standalone app (64-bit, built on Ubuntu 22.04). Checked with pluginval like the Windows version.

entry.title: ARIA 1.3.4
entry.summary: The window opens as large as you left it - also after closing and reopening the DAW (before, it came back at the smallest size). A new instance starts at the size you used last. Saving your own sounds fixed: the save window now opens inside the plugin (before, it could open hidden behind the DAW's plugin window, so nothing got saved). If Windows keeps apps out of the Documents folder, your sounds are saved in AppData instead. A failed save now says so.

entry.title: ARIA 1.3.3
entry.summary: The MPC version of the ARIA VST3: an 8-voice bi-timbral analogue-modelling poly. Two oscillators with wave mix, FM and sync, a mod osc per voice, two ladder filters (series, stereo or parallel), looping envelopes, a chord memory with a chord on every key, an arp with a 16-step pattern, a low split and a diffusion delay. Panel-style touch pages.
